import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    registered = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]
    q = int(data[1 + n])
    queries = [int(x) for x in data[2 + n:2 + n + q]]
    for x in queries:
        found = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if registered[i] == x:
                found = 1
                break
        print(found)

main()
